services.title: HUSKY B / CTDHP Prior Authorization Check
services.description: Evaluates a dental service order at sign-time and returns a card if prior authorization is required under the Connecticut HUSKY B dental benefit (CTDHP). Routed through Connie (statewide HIE) with PA intake at the BeneCare ASO; DTR/PAS and adjudication are performed downstream by Gainwell (DSS fiscal agent, CMAP). Fires at the treatment visit (UC03 Interaction 3), not at the covered-evaluation referral (Interaction 1).
